purpose: Demo capability searches for the Diaspora screen. Each states what the consent-gated search is expected to return for the roles listed: CANDIDATES names the synthetic, consented profiles that must appear (must_include) and the synthetic profiles whose consent is not given or withdrawn that must never appear however well they fit (must_exclude); NO_MATCH means no consented profile in scope fits. tests/test_diaspora_search.py holds this file to the seeded directory. Only id, requirement and expect are served to the web app.

searches.requirement: Who in the diaspora could advise on lithium refinery process skills and on the migration pathway that would carry them?
Renewable energy engineering for remote communities
Nuclear reactor licensing and radiation protection
